verdict.rationale: Jira's features page names all four views in the story, saying users can track work progress 'using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.' However, this is a single marketing line, not in-depth documentation. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on switching between views of the same dataset (e.g., shared filters or per-project availability), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the views work as claimed.
